items.title: Fred Moore Interview, 1959-06-19
items.q: So King Howard used to buy me out... Oh he come to like me very much. We were like to show, we were like to got the band together.

ctx.x: Yeah, record date. Full size. Four records or something. $30. So I, I wanted my money so bad. I need the money so bad, sir. It always take about three weeks before you get your money. So King Howard used to buy me out. So he'd give me $20, $25 right then, so I'd get a record and put it out of my own pocket and pay me right then. I didn't have to wait. Left the fellas of the band, he'd wait to, wait to three or four weeks before the record come out, I mean, before, you know, for the issue of the record. So I'd get…
